name: nextcloud
description: Nextcloud office connector — Files (WebDAV), Notes, Calendar (CalDAV), Shares, Deck, Activity, Talk recording control. Read + write lanes; writes_gated (declared writes are #106-bound, script-composed writes take per-invocation #126 approvals).

commands.name: connect
commands.description: Validate an app password against the instance and store the precomputed Authorization header. Get the app password from the animus-agent account (Settings → Security → Devices & sessions).
commands.script: function run(ctx) local h = 'Basic '..b64.encode(ctx.args.user..':'..ctx.args.app_password) local r = ctx.http.get(ctx.package.get_state('base_url')..'/ocs/v2.php/cloud/user?format=json', {headers = {['Authorization'] = h, ['OCS-APIREQUEST'] = 'true', ['Accept'] = 'application/json'}}) if r.status ~= 200 then return {success = false, output = 'connect failed: HTTP '..tostring(r.status)..(r.error and (' - '..tostring(r.error)) or '')} end local o = r.json and r.json.ocs if not o or not o.data or not o.data.id then return {success = false, output = 'connect failed: unexpected OCS payload (HTTP '..tostring(r.status)..')'} end local ok1 = ctx.package.set_state('user', ctx.args.user) local ok2 = ctx.package.set_state('auth_header', h) if not ok1 or not ok2 then return {success = false, output = 'connect failed: state persist error'} end return {output = 'connected as '..o.data.id..' ('..tostring(o.data['display-name'])..')', data = {user_id = o.data.id}} end

commands.name: files list
commands.description: List files and folders in the account's root folder (PROPFIND, Depth 1)
commands.script: function run(ctx) local b = ctx.request.body or '' local rows = {} for resp in b:gmatch('<d:response>.-</d:response>') do local href = resp:match('<d:href>([^<]+)</d:href>') or '' local is_dir = resp:match('<d:resourcetype>%s*<d:collection') ~= nil local size = resp:match('<d:getcontentlength>([^<]+)<') or '' local mtime = resp:match('<d:getlastmodified>([^<]+)<') or '' local name = href:match('([^/]+)/?$') or href name = name:gsub('%%20', ' ') table.insert(rows, {name = name, type = is_dir and 'dir' or 'file', size = tonumber(size) or 0, modified = mtime, href = href}) end if #rows == 0 then return {success = false, output = 'files list: no response rows parsed - unexpected body shape (HTTP '..tostring(ctx.request.status)..')'} end return {output = #rows..' entries', data = rows} end

commands.name: file put
commands.description: Upload/overwrite a text file (raw-body PUT). Path is relative to the account root; percent-encode special characters (e.g. %20 for spaces).
commands.script: function run(ctx) local r = ctx.request if r.status ~= 201 and r.status ~= 204 then return {success = false, output = 'file put failed: HTTP '..tostring(r.status)} end return {output = 'wrote '..ctx.args.path..' (HTTP '..r.status..')'} end

commands.name: file delete
commands.description: Delete a file or folder (folder delete is recursive). Path relative to account root, percent-encoded as in file put.
commands.script: function run(ctx) local r = ctx.request if r.status ~= 204 then return {success = false, output = 'file delete failed: HTTP '..tostring(r.status)} end return {output = 'deleted '..ctx.args.path} end

commands.name: note list
commands.description: List notes (Notes app API)
commands.script: function run(ctx) local rows = ctx.request.json if type(rows) ~= 'table' then return {success = false, output = 'note list: no JSON payload (HTTP '..tostring(ctx.request.status)..')'} end local out = {} for _, n in ipairs(rows) do table.insert(out, {id = n.id, title = n.title, modified = n.modified}) end return {output = #out..' notes', data = out} end

commands.name: note create
commands.description: Create a note with arbitrary text (Notes app). Body is script-composed via json.encode — per-invocation #126 approval applies (one-shot, payload-bound).
commands.script: function run(ctx) local body = json.encode({title = ctx.args.title, content = ctx.args.content}) local r = ctx.http.post(ctx.package.get_state('base_url')..'/index.php/apps/notes/api/v1/notes', {headers = {['Authorization'] = ctx.package.get_state('auth_header'), ['Accept'] = 'application/json', ['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'}, body = body}) if r.status ~= 200 then return {success = false, output = 'note create failed: HTTP '..tostring(r.status)..(r.error and (' - '..tostring(r.error)) or '')} end local j = r.json or {} return {output = 'note '..tostring(j.id)..': '..tostring(j.title), data = {id = j.id, title = j.title}} end

commands.name: cal list
commands.description: List calendars (CalDAV PROPFIND, Depth 1)
commands.script: function run(ctx) local b = ctx.request.body or '' local rows = {} for resp in b:gmatch('<d:response>.-</d:response>') do local href = resp:match('<d:href>([^<]+)</d:href>') or '' local name = resp:match('<d:displayname>([^<]+)</d:displayname>') if name then table.insert(rows, {name = name, href = href}) end end if #rows == 0 then return {success = false, output = 'cal list: no calendars parsed - unexpected body shape (HTTP '..tostring(ctx.request.status)..')'} end return {output = #rows..' calendars', data = rows} end

commands.name: event put
commands.description: Create/overwrite a calendar event from VEVENT iCalendar text (raw-body PUT). calendar is the calendar id from cal list (e.g. personal); uid names the .ics resource and should match the VEVENT's UID.
commands.script: function run(ctx) local r = ctx.request if r.status ~= 201 and r.status ~= 204 then return {success = false, output = 'event put failed: HTTP '..tostring(r.status)} end return {output = 'event '..ctx.args.uid..' written (HTTP '..r.status..')'} end

commands.name: share create
commands.description: Create a public link share for a file/folder path; returns the share URL. Body is script-composed — per-invocation #126 approval applies.
commands.script: function run(ctx) local body = json.encode({path = ctx.args.path, shareType = 3}) local r = ctx.http.post(ctx.package.get_state('base_url')..'/ocs/v2.php/apps/files_sharing/api/v1/shares?format=json', {headers = {['Authorization'] = ctx.package.get_state('auth_header'), ['OCS-APIREQUEST'] = 'true', ['Accept'] = 'application/json', ['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'}, body = body}) if r.status ~= 200 then return {success = false, output = 'share create failed: HTTP '..tostring(r.status)..(r.error and (' - '..tostring(r.error)) or '')} end local d = r.json and r.json.ocs and r.json.ocs.data if not d or not d.url then return {success = false, output = 'share create: unexpected OCS payload'} end return {output = d.url, data = {id = d.id, url = d.url, token = d.token}} end

commands.name: recording status
commands.description: Read a Talk room's call-recording state. callRecording: 0=none, 1=video, 2=audio, 3=video_starting, 4=audio_starting, 5=failed. Also reports hasCall/activeSince.
commands.script: function run(ctx) local r = ctx.request local j = r.json or {} local d = (j.ocs and j.ocs.data) or {} local rec = tonumber(d.callRecording) if rec == nil then return {success = false, output = 'recording status failed: HTTP '..tostring(r.status)..' - unexpected payload'} end local names = {[0]='none',[1]='video',[2]='audio',[3]='video_starting',[4]='audio_starting',[5]='failed'} return {output = 'callRecording: '..rec..' ('..names[rec]..') | hasCall: '..tostring(d.hasCall)..' | activeSince: '..tostring(d.activeSince), data = {callRecording = rec, state = names[rec], hasCall = d.hasCall, activeSince = d.activeSince}} end

commands.name: recording start
commands.description: Start call recording in a Talk room (moderator required; an active call must exist). status: 1 = video, 2 = audio (number). spreed errors map to reasons: classified/status/recording/call/config.
commands.script: function run(ctx) local r = ctx.request if r.status == 200 then return {output = 'recording start accepted (status '..tostring(ctx.args.status)..'); poll recording status for activation'} end local j = r.json or {} local e = (j.ocs and j.ocs.data and j.ocs.data.error) or nil if e then return {success = false, output = 'recording start failed: HTTP '..tostring(r.status)..' ('..tostring(e)..')'} end return {success = false, output = 'recording start failed: HTTP '..tostring(r.status)} end

commands.name: recording stop
commands.description: Stop call recording in a Talk room (moderator required). The file is finalized and lands in the recording starter's Files under Talk/ (can take a moment after stop).
commands.script: function run(ctx) local r = ctx.request if r.status == 200 then return {output = 'recording stop accepted; finalization in progress'} end return {success = false, output = 'recording stop failed: HTTP '..tostring(r.status)} end

commands.name: file get
commands.description: Download a file (WebDAV GET) into the sandbox files area. Returns {path, size, file} where file is the sandbox slug; content inlined only when <= 4096 bytes (kernel caps result strings - large payloads travel via the files lane, quota files_quota_mb). Binary-safe.
commands.script: function run(ctx) local r = ctx.request if r.status ~= 200 then return {success=false, output='file get failed: HTTP '..tostring(r.status)} end local b = r.body or '' local slug = ctx.args.path:lower():gsub('[^%w._-]+','-') if slug == '' then slug = 'download' end if #slug > 128 then slug = slug:sub(1,128) end if slug:sub(1,1) == '.' then slug = 'dl'..slug end local ok, err = ctx.fs.write(slug, b) if not ok then return {success=false, output='file get: fs write failed: '..tostring(err)} end local d = {path=ctx.args.path, size=#b, file=slug} if #b <= 4096 then d.content = b end return {output='retrieved '..ctx.args.path..' ('..#b..' bytes) -> files:'..slug, data=d} end

commands.name: files list dir
commands.description: List a folder's contents (PROPFIND, Depth 1). path is relative to the account root, percent-encoded (spaces %20), trailing slash optional. Bare-root listing: files list.
commands.script: function run(ctx) local b = ctx.request.body or '' local rows = {} for resp in b:gmatch('<d:response>.-</d:response>') do local href = resp:match('<d:href>([^<]+)</d:href>') or '' local is_dir = resp:match('<d:resourcetype>%s*<d:collection') ~= nil local size = resp:match('<d:getcontentlength>([^<]+)<') or '' local mtime = resp:match('<d:getlastmodified>([^<]+)</d:getlastmodified>') or '' local name = href:match('([^/]+)/?$') or href name = name:gsub('%%20', ' ') table.insert(rows, {name = name, type = is_dir and 'dir' or 'file', size = tonumber(size) or 0, modified = mtime, href = href}) end if #rows == 0 then return {success = false, output = 'files list dir: no response rows parsed - unexpected body shape (HTTP '..tostring(ctx.request.status)..')'} end return {output = #rows..' entries', data = rows} end

commands.name: recordings list
commands.description: List Talk rooms that have call recordings (PROPFIND on Talk/Recording/, Depth 1). Rooms appear after their first finalized recording; each room dir holds the .ogg files (list them via files list dir Talk/Recording/<token>/).
commands.script: function run(ctx) local b = ctx.request.body or '' local rows = {} local n = 0 for resp in b:gmatch('<d:response>.-</d:response>') do n = n + 1 local href = resp:match('<d:href>([^<]+)</d:href>') or '' local is_dir = resp:match('<d:resourcetype>%s*<d:collection') ~= nil local name = href:match('([^/]+)/?$') or href if is_dir and name ~= 'Recording' then table.insert(rows, {room = name, href = href}) end end if n == 0 then return {success = false, output = 'recordings list: no response rows parsed - unexpected body shape (HTTP '..tostring(ctx.request.status)..') - Talk/Recording absent?'} end return {output = #rows..' recorded rooms', data = rows} end

commands.name: share list
commands.description: List link shares (OCS files_sharing). Rows: id, type (3=public link), owner, path, url, token.
commands.script: function run(ctx) local r = ctx.request local j = r.json or {} local meta = (j.ocs and j.ocs.meta) or {} local d = (j.ocs and j.ocs.data) or {} if meta.statuscode and meta.statuscode ~= 200 then return {success = false, output = 'share list failed: OCS '..tostring(meta.statuscode)..' '..tostring(meta.message or '')} end if type(d) ~= 'table' then return {success = false, output = 'share list: unexpected OCS payload (HTTP '..tostring(r.status)..')'} end local rows = {} for _, s in ipairs(d) do table.insert(rows, {id = s.id, type = s.share_type, owner = s.uid_owner, path = s.file_target or s.path, url = s.url, token = s.token}) end return {output = #rows..' shares', data = rows} end

commands.name: share delete
commands.description: Delete a share by id (OCS files_sharing). Write - per-invocation #126 approval applies.
commands.script: function run(ctx) local r = ctx.http.delete(ctx.package.get_state('base_url')..'/ocs/v2.php/apps/files_sharing/api/v1/shares/'..tostring(ctx.args.id)..'?format=json', {headers = {['Authorization'] = ctx.package.get_state('auth_header'), ['OCS-APIREQUEST'] = 'true', ['Accept'] = 'application/json'}}) if r.status ~= 200 then return {success = false, output = 'share delete failed: HTTP '..tostring(r.status)..(r.error and (' - '..tostring(r.error)) or '')} end local j = r.json or {} local meta = (j.ocs and j.ocs.meta) or {} if meta.statuscode and meta.statuscode ~= 200 then return {success = false, output = 'share delete failed: OCS '..tostring(meta.statuscode)..' '..tostring(meta.message or '')} end return {output = 'share '..tostring(ctx.args.id)..' deleted'} end

commands.name: deck boards
commands.description: List Deck boards (REST). Rows: id, title, color, archived.
commands.script: function run(ctx) local r = ctx.request if r.status ~= 200 then return {success = false, output = 'deck boards failed: HTTP '..tostring(r.status)} end local j = r.json if type(j) ~= 'table' then return {success = false, output = 'deck boards: unexpected payload (HTTP '..tostring(r.status)..')'} end local rows = {} for _, b in ipairs(j) do table.insert(rows, {id = b.id, title = b.title, color = b.color, archived = b.archived}) end return {output = #rows..' boards', data = rows} end

commands.name: deck stacks
commands.description: List a board's stacks with their cards (REST). Rows: id, title, cards[{id,title}].
commands.script: function run(ctx) local r = ctx.request if r.status ~= 200 then return {success = false, output = 'deck stacks failed: HTTP '..tostring(r.status)} end local j = r.json if type(j) ~= 'table' then return {success = false, output = 'deck stacks: unexpected payload (HTTP '..tostring(r.status)..')'} end local rows = {} for _, s in ipairs(j) do local cards = {} if type(s.cards) == 'table' then for _, c in ipairs(s.cards) do table.insert(cards, {id = c.id, title = c.title}) end end table.insert(rows, {id = s.id, title = s.title, cards = cards}) end if #rows == 0 then return {success = false, output = 'deck stacks: no stacks parsed (HTTP '..tostring(r.status)..') - board exists?'} end return {output = #rows..' stacks', data = rows} end

commands.name: deck card create
commands.description: Create a card in a stack (REST). description optional. Write - per-invocation #126 approval applies.
commands.script: function run(ctx) local body = {title = ctx.args.title} if ctx.args.description then body.description = ctx.args.description end local r = ctx.http.post(ctx.package.get_state('base_url')..'/index.php/apps/deck/api/v1.0/boards/'..tostring(ctx.args.board)..'/stacks/'..tostring(ctx.args.stack)..'/cards', {headers = {['Authorization'] = ctx.package.get_state('auth_header'), ['Accept'] = 'application/json', ['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'}, body = json.encode(body)}) if r.status ~= 200 then return {success = false, output = 'deck card create failed: HTTP '..tostring(r.status)..(r.error and (' - '..tostring(r.error)) or '')} end local j = r.json or {} return {output = 'card '..tostring(j.id)..': '..tostring(j.title), data = {id = j.id, title = j.title, stackId = j.stackId}} end

commands.name: deck card update
commands.description: Update a card's title and/or description (REST PUT). At least one of title/description required. Write - per-invocation #126 approval applies.
commands.script: function run(ctx) if ctx.args.title == nil and ctx.args.description == nil then return {success = false, output = 'deck card update: nothing to update (title or description required)'} end local body = {} if ctx.args.title ~= nil then body.title = ctx.args.title end if ctx.args.description ~= nil then body.description = ctx.args.description end local r = ctx.http.put(ctx.package.get_state('base_url')..'/index.php/apps/deck/api/v1.0/boards/'..tostring(ctx.args.board)..'/stacks/'..tostring(ctx.args.stack)..'/cards/'..tostring(ctx.args.card), {headers = {['Authorization'] = ctx.package.get_state('auth_header'), ['Accept'] = 'application/json', ['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'}, body = json.encode(body)}) if r.status ~= 200 then return {success = false, output = 'deck card update failed: HTTP '..tostring(r.status)..(r.error and (' - '..tostring(r.error)) or '')} end local j = r.json or {} return {output = 'card '..tostring(j.id)..': '..tostring(j.title), data = {id = j.id, title = j.title, stackId = j.stackId}} end

commands.name: deck card move
commands.description: Move a card to another stack (REST PUT with stackId). to_stack is the target stack id. Write - per-invocation #126 approval applies.
commands.script: function run(ctx) local r = ctx.http.put(ctx.package.get_state('base_url')..'/index.php/apps/deck/api/v1.0/boards/'..tostring(ctx.args.board)..'/stacks/'..tostring(ctx.args.stack)..'/cards/'..tostring(ctx.args.card), {headers = {['Authorization'] = ctx.package.get_state('auth_header'), ['Accept'] = 'application/json', ['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'}, body = json.encode({stackId = tonumber(ctx.args.to_stack)})}) if r.status ~= 200 then return {success = false, output = 'deck card move failed: HTTP '..tostring(r.status)..(r.error and (' - '..tostring(r.error)) or '')} end local j = r.json or {} return {output = 'card '..tostring(ctx.args.card)..' -> stack '..tostring(j.stackId or ctx.args.to_stack), data = {id = j.id, stackId = j.stackId}} end

commands.name: deck card delete
commands.description: Delete a card (REST). Write - per-invocation #126 approval applies.
commands.script: function run(ctx) local r = ctx.http.delete(ctx.package.get_state('base_url')..'/index.php/apps/deck/api/v1.0/boards/'..tostring(ctx.args.board)..'/stacks/'..tostring(ctx.args.stack)..'/cards/'..tostring(ctx.args.card), {headers = {['Authorization'] = ctx.package.get_state('auth_header'), ['Accept'] = 'application/json'}}) if r.status ~= 200 and r.status ~= 204 then return {success = false, output = 'deck card delete failed: HTTP '..tostring(r.status)..(r.error and (' - '..tostring(r.error)) or '')} end return {output = 'card '..tostring(ctx.args.card)..' deleted'} end

commands.name: note get
commands.description: Fetch one note by id (Notes app API). Returns {id, title, content, modified}. Content travels in the result lane - kernel caps oversized strings.
commands.script: function run(ctx) local r = ctx.request local j = r.json or {} if r.status ~= 200 or j.id == nil then return {success = false, output = 'note get failed: HTTP '..tostring(r.status)} end return {output = 'note '..tostring(j.id)..': '..tostring(j.title), data = {id = j.id, title = j.title, content = j.content, modified = j.modified}} end

commands.name: note update
commands.description: Update a note's title and/or content by id (Notes app API PUT). At least one of title/content required. Write - per-invocation #126 approval applies.
commands.script: function run(ctx) if ctx.args.title == nil and ctx.args.content == nil then return {success = false, output = 'note update: nothing to update (title or content required)'} end local body = {} if ctx.args.title ~= nil then body.title = ctx.args.title end if ctx.args.content ~= nil then body.content = ctx.args.content end local r = ctx.http.put(ctx.package.get_state('base_url')..'/index.php/apps/notes/api/v1/notes/'..tostring(ctx.args.id), {headers = {['Authorization'] = ctx.package.get_state('auth_header'), ['Accept'] = 'application/json', ['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'}, body = json.encode(body)}) if r.status ~= 200 then return {success = false, output = 'note update failed: HTTP '..tostring(r.status)..(r.error and (' - '..tostring(r.error)) or '')} end local j = r.json or {} return {output = 'note '..tostring(j.id)..': '..tostring(j.title), data = {id = j.id, title = j.title, modified = j.modified}} end

commands.name: note delete
commands.description: Delete a note by id (Notes app API). Write - per-invocation #126 approval applies.
commands.script: function run(ctx) local r = ctx.http.delete(ctx.package.get_state('base_url')..'/index.php/apps/notes/api/v1/notes/'..tostring(ctx.args.id), {headers = {['Authorization'] = ctx.package.get_state('auth_header'), ['Accept'] = 'application/json'}}) if r.status ~= 200 and r.status ~= 204 then return {success = false, output = 'note delete failed: HTTP '..tostring(r.status)..(r.error and (' - '..tostring(r.error)) or '')} end return {output = 'note '..tostring(ctx.args.id)..' deleted'} end

commands.name: event query
commands.description: Find events in a UTC time range (CalDAV REPORT calendar-query). start/end are iCalendar UTC datetimes like 20261116T000000Z; calendar is the calendar name from cal list. Rows: uid, summary, dtstart, href.

request.body: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?><c:calendar-query xmlns:d="DAV:" xmlns:c="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:caldav"><d:prop><d:getetag/><c:calendar-data/></d:prop><c:filter><c:comp-filter name="VCALENDAR"><c:comp-filter name="VEVENT"><c:time-range start="{{args.start}}" end="{{args.end}}"/></c:comp-filter></c:comp-filter></c:filter></c:calendar-query>

commands.script: function run(ctx) local b = ctx.request.body or '' local rows = {} local n = 0 for resp in b:gmatch('<d:response>.-</d:response>') do n = n + 1 local href = resp:match('<d:href>([^<]+)</d:href>') or '' local ics = resp:match('<cal:calendar%-data>(.-)</cal:calendar%-data>') or resp:match('<x1:calendar%-data>(.-)</x1:calendar%-data>') or '' if href ~= '' and ics ~= '' then local uid = ics:match('UID:([^%c%s]+)') or (href:match('([^/]+)%.ics$') or href) local summary = ics:match('SUMMARY:([^%c]+)') or '' summary = summary:gsub('%s+$', '') local dtstart = ics:match('DTSTART:([^%c]+)') or '' dtstart = dtstart:gsub('%s+$', '') table.insert(rows, {uid = uid, summary = summary, dtstart = dtstart, href = href}) end end if n == 0 then return {success = false, output = 'event query: no response rows parsed - unexpected body shape (HTTP '..tostring(ctx.request.status)..')'} end return {output = #rows..' events in range', data = rows} end

commands.name: event delete
commands.description: Delete an event by uid (CalDAV DELETE on the .ics resource). Write - per-invocation #126 approval applies.
commands.script: function run(ctx) local r = ctx.request if r.status ~= 200 and r.status ~= 204 then return {success = false, output = 'event delete failed: HTTP '..tostring(r.status)} end return {output = 'event '..tostring(ctx.args.uid)..' deleted'} end

commands.name: activity feed
commands.description: Read the Activity feed (OCS v2). limit is rows per page (20-50 sane). Rows: id, app, type, user, subject, when.
commands.script: function run(ctx) local r = ctx.request local j = r.json or {} local meta = (j.ocs and j.ocs.meta) or {} local d = (j.ocs and j.ocs.data) or {} if meta.statuscode and meta.statuscode ~= 200 then return {success = false, output = 'activity feed failed: OCS '..tostring(meta.statuscode)..' '..tostring(meta.message or '')} end if type(d) ~= 'table' then return {success = false, output = 'activity feed: unexpected OCS payload (HTTP '..tostring(r.status)..')'} end local rows = {} for _, a in ipairs(d) do table.insert(rows, {id = a.activity_id, app = a.app, type = a.type, user = a.user, subject = a.subject, when = a.datetime}) end return {output = #rows..' activity rows', data = rows} end
